title: L1 Recommendations
intro: Every L1 statement this adaptation is built on, as authored in `library/l1-recommendation-scenarios/uganda/`. Each is a verbatim quote of its source and links to the ingested source in the library and to the section that holds its page or slide. The same statements, with their WHO-vocabulary mapping, are on the [L1 extraction viewer](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-immunizations-uganda/en/smart-base/l1-extraction/smart-immunizations-uganda/).
